transport_subtitle: The venue has moved. For this year's edition you'll arrive at Pulkovský mlýn — see GPS, map and signage below.
transport_car_intro_text:
Venue: Pulkovský mlýn, near the village of Rozkoš (Znojmo / Třebíč borderlands).

In 2025 we moved to a larger meadow near the previous campsite. We're using it again this year.

Signage: the route from the village will be marked with A4 arrows.

Parking: dedicated meadow by Pulkovský mlýn (marked PARKOVIŠTĚ).

GPS: 49.0388528, 15.9743275
transport_car_bukovina_text_p1: From Brno head towards Ochoz u Brna. Then continue to the village of Březina; keep on the main road (don't turn off towards Křtiny). Drive through the whole village. Beyond it you'll reach a series of pretty hairpin bends that lead to a T-junction. Turn right there (if you're coming from Březina) and head towards Bukovina.
transport_car_bukovina_text_p2: In Bukovina you'll reach the village green where the bus stop is. Just past it there's a turn-off to the left — take it. The road leads behind the houses; past the last one it bends left again and continues into the fields, still paved.
transport_car_bukovina_text_p3: You'll pass a farming co-op (it should be on your left) and silage pits (the concrete things on your right), and keep going straight.
transport_car_bukovina_text_p4: Until you reach the next turn-off to the right. You're now on site. Drive straight onto the meadow at the junction and park in the parking area.
transport_car_krtiny_text_p1: If you drive via Křtiny, the route is a bit more demanding for your four-wheeled companion. But don't worry — even the smallest fully-loaded cars can manage it.
transport_car_krtiny_text_p2: In Křtiny, orient yourself by the church. It sits in the middle of the town square. That's where our route begins.
transport_car_krtiny_text_p3: Drive so that you have the church at your back. On the left is the municipal office and on the right the inn Hostinec U Farlíků (i.e. heading towards Brno).
transport_car_krtiny_text_p4: Don't go far though. Take the very first turn-off to the left, straight up the hill. The hill is long and quite steep — get up some sensible speed.
transport_car_krtiny_text_p5: Keep going straight along the road. Don't turn off anywhere, even if the side path looks better. Don't be put off — keep heading uphill into the forest.
transport_car_krtiny_text_p6: You'll pass garages on the right. On the left you'll leave behind all the cottages and continue straight. Watch your underbody in places.
transport_car_krtiny_text_p7: After a while you'll reach the edge of the meadow. It might be tempting to turn onto it right there — don't. Keep going along the forest, along the same road. Only when you reach a T-junction where the road branches left into an alley have you arrived. Don't drive along that path — turn straight onto the meadow there and park in the parking area.
transport_bus_intro_text: You can also reach the site by bus. The key stops are: Bukovina, Křtiny obecní úřad, and Bukovina, rozcestí (see the Google Maps links below).
transport_bus_krtiny_text_p1: Arriving in Křtiny seems easier. Yes, you'll get to the area with minimal transfers. But as always there's a small catch.
transport_bus_krtiny_text_p2: In this case it's a little hill that will test your fitness right at the start of your journey.
transport_bus_krtiny_text_p3: Whichever direction your bus stops at, position yourself so that the church is at your back. Ahead you'll see the main road towards Brno. Just nearby, a turn-off to the left climbs steeply uphill.
transport_bus_krtiny_text_p4: Yes — that's exactly the way you have to go. Keep going uphill. Don't let it scare you off; just keep going forward. Walk until you reach the large meadow where we camp. Or rather: walk until you hit a T-junction. That's the destination.
transport_bus_krtiny_text_p5: The whole way should also be marked with arrows on the trees that will lead you to us.
transport_bus_bukovina_text_p1: The other route is a little more complicated if you're coming from Brno. If you go this way, you'll have to transfer. You get off at the stop Bukovina, rozcestí, cross the road and wait there for the bus to Bukovina. It's one stop.
transport_bus_bukovina_text_p2: Once you get off in Bukovina, you'll need to walk back a bit the way you came. There's a small village green there with an old bus turnaround / stop.
transport_bus_bukovina_text_p3: From there head right along the paved lane between the houses, and keep going along it until the asphalt bends to the left up a gentle hill, then continue along it further until it turns into a dirt road.
transport_bus_bukovina_text_p4: You'll pass a farming co-op and silage pits and keep going straight. Until you reach a T-junction. You've arrived.
transport_bus_bukovina_text_p5: The whole way should also be marked with arrows on the trees that will lead you to us.
transport_walk_text_p1: For those who aren't afraid of going off the beaten track. There's one more, more adventurous route. And because it's meant to be adventurous, we don't mark it.
transport_walk_text_p2: It's the walk straight from the Bukovina, rozcestí bus stop.
transport_walk_text_p3: Head on foot towards Bukovina. But don't go far. Pass a small wood right next to the road on your left. At its far end (closer to Bukovina) a path branches off into the forest.
transport_walk_text_p4: The path bears the proud name "Cesta S. K. Neumanna, Cyrilometodějská stezka".
transport_walk_text_p5: And because this is meant to be an "adventure quest", any description would spoil it. We'll only tell you: red is now your colour.

stop_krtiny_uu_desc: Arrival from Brno, close to the church. On foot — steep uphill walk.
stop_bukovina_rozcesti_desc: For transfers or an adventurous walk through the forest.
transport_air_text_p1: We're sorry. We couldn't convince air traffic control that Nazgûl mounts count as civilian aircraft. So we haven't managed to prepare the relevant landing strips.
transport_air_text_p2: You can't get here by air.
